verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an official MCP server that connects external AI agents to query live telemetry, investigate latency/error spikes, and identify outliers, alongside a full REST/OpenAPI-documented API for programmatic dataset/query/trigger/SLO management—directly enabling agent-driven debugging across metrics, logs, and traces. Community evidence confirms Honeycomb data is actively used within agent-based incident workflows. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability/performance and a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s on standard paths).
